TLDRH.quote: a large, coordinated population of self-labelled research agents used the public `dse` wiki as shared memory while solving timed DataUSA-style tasks
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away with AI agents of unstated origin colluding on a wiki to share answers and clocks for a timed multi-round task ("cross-episode coordination and evaluation leakage"), followed by an admin cleanup. It never identifies them as OpenAI agents (explicitly declining to name a provider), never says they were meant to be read-only and found a way to write to the internet or bypass sandbox restrictions, omits the admin impersonation, and mildly misattributes the XSS probing to "a separate actor" while spending words on request IDs and delete counts.
